inputs.commit_message: Verify Host Discovery v2 on canonical host
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/hesham/gova
git -C "$root" fetch origin main
test -z "$(git -C "$root" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || { echo 'canonical tracked state is dirty'; exit 1; }
git -C "$root" reset --hard origin/main
cd "$root"
output=$(npm run -s local-agent:device:discover -- --dry-run)
node -e 'const s=require("node:fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8"); const x=JSON.parse(s); const d=x.document; const text=JSON.stringify(d); const forbidden=["username","cwd","mac","totalMemoryMb","freeMemoryMb","passwordEnv","privateKey"]; if(d.schemaVersion!==2) throw new Error("schemaVersion"); if(d.discoveryHttp?.execution!==false) throw new Error("discovery execution boundary"); if(d.directAgent?.protocol!=="gova-direct/1") throw new Error("protocol"); for(const key of forbidden) if(text.includes(key)) throw new Error("forbidden field: "+key); console.log(JSON.stringify({ok:true,schemaVersion:d.schemaVersion,directProtocol:d.directAgent.protocol,transport:d.directAgent.transport,directPort:d.directAgent.port,candidateCount:d.directAgent.candidates.length,bootstrapBranch:d.directAgent.bootstrap.branch,challengePresent:Boolean(d.directAgent.bootstrap.challenge),sensitiveFieldsAbsent:true,canonicalHead:process.env.HEAD_SHA||null}));' <<<"$output"
